## Description
A shader pack created to convey the style of the cancelled __Super Duper Graphics Pack__ and other popular Minecraft titles. Developed by [@Eldeston](https://github.com/Eldeston), and presented by __FlameRender Studios__.

## Sponsored by Ember Host

This shader is sponsored by **Ember Host**. Open the image above or use the code [**SUPERFLAME**](https://billing.ember.host/aff.php?aff=23) to claim your discount to get ***10%*** off on your first purchase!

Choose **Ember Host** to host your Minecraft server and take advantage of their **powerful AMD processors** and go beyond with excellent prices! Get ***70%*** of your first purchase will support the development of Super Duper Vanilla!

## License 
This shader uses the **FlameRender (C) Studios License**. See [**LICENSE**](LICENSE) for more info.

## Version Compatibility
Version compatibility varies across the 2 known shader loaders Iris and Optifine. Iris versions 1.6.10+ from Minecraft versions 1.18.2+ are compatible with this shader. For Optifine, it varies across GPU vendors. Please always choose the latest Iris or Optifine of your respective Minecraft version.

Optifine support will not be prioritized or maintained starting from version 1.3.7 of this shader.

| Iris     | Windows, Linux (Intel, AMD, NVidia) | Apple (M1)      |
| -------- | ----------------------------------- | --------------- |
| 1.18.2+  | Supported                           | Supported       |
| 1.17.1-  | Not supported                       | Not supported   |

| Optifine | Windows, Linux (Intel, AMD, NVidia) | Apple (M1)      |
| -------- | ----------------------------------- | --------------- |
| 1.17.1+  | Partial support                     | Partial support |
| 1.14.2+  | Partial support                     | Not supported   |
| 1.13.2-  | Not supported                       | Not supported   |

## Official CurseForge Page
Super Duper Vanilla is also on CurseForge! Stable and latest releases will always be available there. Check it out [here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/customization/super-duper-vanilla-shaders) and support me by using any one of the download links there!

versions.name: Super Duper Vanilla 1.3.8
versions.changelog:
Hey everyone! It has been a looooong while since Super Duper Vanilla updated and missed out a bunch ever since my college days started. After finishing 1st year, Super Duper Vanilla has been on a development spree, squashing bugs, adding new features, and completing Distant Horizons support!

Thank you again for your support for Super Duper Vanilla and helping it reach another milestone on Modrinth, with over 2 million downloads!

## FOR OPTIFINE USERS
It is heavily recommended to use Iris/Oculus for this shader to experience this version. Optifine support has since been dropped in 1.3.7.

Regardless, this version only has partial support for Optifine! Any visual bug or error will be expected. So here be dragons!

# Patch Notes 1.3.8
- Completed Distant Horizons support

- Improved world border graphics
- Improved Nether portal graphics
- Improved End portal graphics
- Improved shader menu tooltips (language translations may need updating)

- Added sculk noise
- Added volumetric clouds
- Added new settings for clouds
- Added new settings for iPBR
- Added Iris tags support (for long term compatibility for new MC versions for iPBR)
- Added pt_BR.lang ([@chocotoneg](https://github.com/chocotoneg))

- Fixed boat shadows in water
- Fixed Distant Horizons shadows by removing them (modern problems require modern solutions)
- Fixed player various translucency issues including hand translucents (EMOTIONAL DAMAGE)
- Fixed error when disabling water foam
- Fixed incorrect gilded blackstone iPBR
- Fixed FXAA (For some reason, this wasn't fixed since 1.3.5 💀)

- Updated iPBR for new Minecraft versions up until 1.21.5+
- Partial mod support for "Farmer's Delight" and "The Undergarden"
- Vanilla clouds now use story mode style clouds
- Adjusted daylight colors (now more neutral)
- Code and pipeline refactoring
- Reduced glint strength
- More documentation

versions.name: Super Duper Vanilla 1.3.7
versions.changelog:
Hello everyone! Happy holidays! Super Duper Vanilla updates has not been frequent recently because I had only just begun college life. So I will at least release 1.3.7 before the year ends with more Distant Horizons support.

## NOTE
DH support is still experimental, so please report bugs and errors on the main Github repository!

So thank you again for your support for Super Duper Vanilla and helping it reach another milestone on Modrinth, with over 1 million downloads!

## FOR OPTIFINE USERS
This version marks as the end of support for Optifine (no more patches dedicated to Optifine to work as intended). Starting from this version, Super Duper Vanilla will begin transitioning to Iris.

# Patch Notes 1.3.7
- Massively improved Distant Horizons support
- Improved ender dragon death beam
- Improved light volumetrics visibility

- Added story mode clouds settings
- Added leave animations for winter drop blocks
- Added pt_BR.lang ([@chocotoneg](https://github.com/chocotoneg))

- Fixed warden emissives not pulsing
- Fixed errors with outlines

- Updated documentation
- Updated license
